text:
sara_ae: FYI CobaltBridge just sent the RFI back — they want a clear plan for the POC (timeline + success criteria), confirmation we can use their HSM, and a pricing outline for a reserved tier. attaching the RFI PDF in the thread.

mike_se: thanks. do we have a suggested POC scope that hits latency/cost/regulatory asks? they specifically called out <50ms p95 and on-prem KMS/HSM integration.

amanda_se: ok thinking out loud: 2-week POC, 1 dedicated GPU node (g5-like), pre-warm cache, and an eval harness with 3 prompt suites (latency, throughput, correctness). success: p95 < 60ms on prod-analog load and <5% quality regression vs baseline. can tighten to 50ms if they allow batching/caching config.

sara_ae: they'll push back on any "dedicated" ask if price is high. procurement asked for a price band for reserved capacity + a pay-as-you-go fallback.

mike_se: for HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed keys via Cloud KMS (we have docs). on-prem HSM is more manual—requires our Private deployment (VPC + on-prem package). need to confirm if CobaltBridge will accept Private or wants Hosted with HSM endpoint.

amanda_se: copied from our runbook — minimal checklist for on-prem HSM:
```
- customer provides PKCS#11 compatible HSM or HSM-as-a-service endpoint
- network peering and route tables configured
- offline key import plan (if required)
- SAML/SCIM for identity integration
- audit log shipping config
```

sara_ae: @deepa_legal can you review any legal blockers for onboarding an HSM in a POC (temp key escrow / contract addendum)?

deepa_legal: quick read: two items — (1) we need an NDA addendum referencing access to keys during the POC; (2) liability clause for on-prem HSM access and key custody. I'll draft a short addendum and ping pricing if we need a CLIN for HSM support.

procurement_bot: Uploaded: cobaltbridge_rfi_2026-02-03.pdf (3.1 MB)

mike_se: also note network: if they want peered VPC, we need peering diagram + expected egress (GB/day) for cost calc. ask them for a baseline workload sample.

amanda_se: suggested pricing bands for the POC (ballpark for initial ask):
- Hosted PAYG: $0.015/token gen (sample) + infra metering
- Dedicated POC (reserved 2-week): $8k flat + token/unit charges
- Private (on-prem lift): $40k one-time deploy fee + support retainer
These are placeholders — finalize after we see egress and HSM complexity.

sara_ae: can you put these into a short slide for the buyer? they want a single-sheet capability matrix that maps our features to their rubric (HSM, SOC2, latency, SLOs, data residency).

amanda_se: I can. I'll reuse the capability matrix template and highlight gaps. note: our SOC2 and compliance docs are in the playbook link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2.

mike_se: here's a minimal command snippet customers run to validate connectivity (we ask them to run and share output):
```bash
curl -sS https://redwood-check.example.com/health -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | jq .
```

sara_ae: procurement requested an explicit list of open-source base models we plan to serve in the POC and quantization/precision options. amanda, can you add to the matrix: model, quantized support (4/8-bit), perf baseline?

amanda_se: will add. quick notes: Llama-2-13B (8-bit q4 tested), Falcon-40B (mixed results on amp), Mistral-7B (good latency). will include perf numbers from our benchmark folder.

sara_ae: timeline ask: they want a kickoff next Monday (5 business days). is that realistic?

mike_se: doable if procurement signs and we get HSM & network details by Wednesday. otherwise push to the following Monday.

deepa_legal: I'll aim to have the NDA addendum by EOD tomorrow.

amanda_se: I'll drop the capability matrix + POC slide in this thread by EOD today.

sara_ae: perfect. one more: they asked whether we can expose per-route token cost breakdown during the POC (they want transparency for chargeback). is that available in the Dedicated or Hosted dashboards?

mike_se: hosted has per-route token breakdown and realtime cost metrics in Console (we can enable a read-only token for them). Dedicated yes, with limited retention unless add-on. Private would require additional telemetry config. I'll note retention limits in the matrix.

procurement_bot: Uploaded: cobaltbridge_network_diagram.png

amanda_se: added the first draft matrix: attachment: cobaltbridge_capability_matrix_draft.xlsx and a one-pager: cobaltbridge_poc_plan.pdf

sara_ae: thanks! I'll push this to their procurement contact and flag the NDA addendum. @deepa_legal if you can CC pricing when you have the addendum that would be great.

deepa_legal: sure — I'll loop in @mike_se-pricing and @sara_ae.

mike_se: noted. I'll prepare a slide with two pricing scenarios (POC discounted, enterprise reserved).

amanda_se: quick heads up — if they want HSM key wrapping via their HSM for hosted, we need to confirm our KMS adapter supports their vendor (Thales/Entrust/YubiHSM). ask them vendor model.

sara_ae: added to email thread to buyer: "please confirm HSM vendor and provide sample workload (1-hour trace)"

amanda_se: last item: I'll include a small test harness snippet and an eval checklist (latency script, throughput script, and sample prompt set).

sara_ae: awesome. closing this thread for now — will reopen if buyer pushes dates. :thumbsup:
